📍Riga, the capital of Latvia 🇱🇻,  🎄📆 Riga Christmas Market: Nov 29 – Jan 2 The city transforms into a magical winter wonderland during the 🎄✨Christmas season.  It’s located in the heart of Old Town, at Dome Square.  There are plenty’s of 🛍️Artisan Crafts and Gifts. You can try traditional 🌭Latvian Delicacies such as 🫛🥓grey peas with bacon, 🥟piragi , 🍪gingerbread cookies and steaming cups of hot mulled wine with traditional Latvian’s 🍷Balsam.  🎶The market hosts live performances of traditional Latvian folk music, carol singing 🎤, and dancing.
